text: {"lessons":["I should evaluate each holding by its future prospects, not by whether it is above or below my purchase price; selling a winner feels good, but that feeling is not a sound investment reason.","Selling winners did not protect the account from declines elsewhere. I should make decisions for the portfolio as a whole rather than treating each stock as a separate account.","A short run of random price moves offers little guidance about what comes next. I should avoid reading patterns into it and trade only when I have a sound reason."]}
